units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|Shortly after landing here, you are approached by a tall Successor in unusual dress; though dark, it shimmers in the light with many little golden flecks. It is unlike any other Successor outfit you've seen. "Greetings, Captain," they say, curiously sonorous. "Noble House Aqrabe kindly requests thy presence in the eastern spaceport reliquary. I've been instructed to take thee there, at thy own discretion, of course."|23|0
units.english: Shortly after landing here, you are approached by a tall Successor in unusual dress; though dark, it shimmers in the light with many little golden flecks. It is unlike any other Successor outfit you've seen. "Greetings, Captain," they say, curiously sonorous. "Noble House Aqrabe kindly requests thy presence in the eastern spaceport reliquary. I've been instructed to take thee there, at thy own discretion, of course."
units.italian: Poco dopo essere atterrato, ti si avvicina un Successore alto, in un abito insolito: scuro, ma scintilla alla luce di molte piccole pagliuzze dorate. Non somiglia a nessun altro abito di Successore che tu abbia visto. "Salve, capitano," dicono, con una voce curiosamente sonora. "La nobile Casa Aqrabe chiede cortesemente la tua presenza nel reliquiario dello spazioporto orientale. Mi è stato ordinato di accompagnarti, se tu lo desideri, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"Very well."|25|0
units.english: "Very well."
units.italian: "Molto bene."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"No, thank you."|27|0
units.english: "No, thank you."
units.italian: "No, grazie."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	They lead you through several restricted areas of the spaceport to a thin tower on its periphery. The room you enter into is tremendous and circular; an enormous hemispherical tank is suspended above a shallow depression in the center, almost touching the wet floor as it swoops towards downward. The contents of the tank prove even more striking, however: Slowly, what look like the severed limbs of Successors begin to descend, each connected to several glittering golden threads that snake up into the dark abyss of the overhead water. You look around to ask your guide what's happening, but they have already left. At the edge of your vision, an arm rubs up against the glass, its undead suckers making faint popping sounds as they pass over it.|30|0
units.english: They lead you through several restricted areas of the spaceport to a thin tower on its periphery. The room you enter into is tremendous and circular; an enormous hemispherical tank is suspended above a shallow depression in the center, almost touching the wet floor as it swoops towards downward. The contents of the tank prove even more striking, however: Slowly, what look like the severed limbs of Successors begin to descend, each connected to several glittering golden threads that snake up into the dark abyss of the overhead water. You look around to ask your guide what's happening, but they have already left. At the edge of your vision, an arm rubs up against the glass, its undead suckers making faint popping sounds as they pass over it.
units.italian: Ti guidano attraverso diverse aree riservate dello spazioporto fino a una torre sottile alla periferia. La stanza in cui entri è enorme e circolare; un gigantesco serbatoio emisferico è sospeso sopra una depressione poco profonda al centro, quasi a sfiorare il pavimento bagnato mentre scende verso il basso. Il contenuto del serbatoio è però ancora più impressionante: lentamente, quelli che sembrano gli arti recisi di Successori cominciano a scendere, ciascuno legato a diversi filamenti dorati e scintillanti che serpeggiano su nell'abisso scuro dell'acqua sovrastante. Ti guardi intorno per chiedere alla tua guida che cosa stia succedendo, ma se n'è già andata. Al margine della tua vista, un braccio striscia contro il vetro, e le sue ventose non morte producono deboli schiocchi mentre passano.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	(Reach out to touch it.)|32|0
units.english: (Reach out to touch it.)
units.italian: (Allunga la mano per toccarlo.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	(Leave it alone.)|33|0
units.english: (Leave it alone.)
units.italian: (Lascialo stare.)

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	As you graze the glass with your fingertips, the bodiless arms wiggle and squirm. From beneath you, a chorus of artificial voices speak.|35|0
units.english: As you graze the glass with your fingertips, the bodiless arms wiggle and squirm. From beneath you, a chorus of artificial voices speak.
units.italian: Sfiorando il vetro con la punta delle dita, i bracci senza corpo si agitano e si contorcono. Da sotto di te, un coro di voci artificiali prende a parlare.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"four-leg? foreign?"|36|0
units.english: "four-leg? foreign?"
units.italian: "quattro zampe? straniero?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|		"foreign."|37|0
units.english: "foreign."
units.italian: "straniero."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"curious foreigner. alien."|38|0
units.english: "curious foreigner. alien."
units.italian: "straniero curioso. alieno."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|			"curiosity, the fortieth virtue."|39|0
units.english: "curiosity, the fortieth virtue."
units.italian: "la curiosità, la quarantesima virtù."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|		"may an alien be virtuous? discuss."|40|0
units.english: "may an alien be virtuous? discuss."
units.italian: "può un alieno essere virtuoso? discutiamo."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"no, think I, for..."|41|0
units.english: "no, think I, for..."
units.italian: "no, penso io, perché..."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	The voices are interrupted by another, this one startlingly close and real.|42|0
units.english: The voices are interrupted by another, this one startlingly close and real.
units.italian: Le voci sono interrotte da un'altra, questa spaventosamente vicina e reale.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"I see thou hast met our saints, Captain." Another Successor emerges from behind you. They wear a similar outfit as the one before, with the only difference seeming to be a slightly redder-hued glint. The "saints" now follow them around, probing and slapping at the glass.|44|0
units.english: "I see thou hast met our saints, Captain." Another Successor emerges from behind you. They wear a similar outfit as the one before, with the only difference seeming to be a slightly redder-hued glint. The "saints" now follow them around, probing and slapping at the glass.
units.italian: "Vedo che hai incontrato i nostri santi, capitano." Un altro Successore emerge da dietro di te. Indossano un abito simile al precedente, con l'unica differenza di un luccichio di tonalità un po' più rossa. I "santi" ora li seguono in giro, tastando e picchiando sul vetro.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"Saints?"|46|0
units.english: "Saints?"
units.italian: "Santi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"Are they alive?"|48|0
units.english: "Are they alive?"
units.italian: "Sono vivi?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"Who are you?"|49|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"No, nor has the cloak of death enveloped them either. They're between things. Like infants that never fear growing; like half-sleepers that never fear to wake."|51|0
units.english: "No, nor has the cloak of death enveloped them either. They're between things. Like infants that never fear growing; like half-sleepers that never fear to wake."
units.italian: "No, né li ha avvolti il manto della morte. Sono fra le cose. Come neonati che non temono di crescere; come dormienti a metà che non temono di svegliarsi."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"They're saints, or relics," they say. "Fragments of unliving minds, free of pain and death, surviving in parts. Each one was once a mind of renown, one worth preserving even as a memory. They're intrigued by thee. Only one of them ever saw something of your kind, and it did not expect to ever see one of you again - not even in eternity."|53|0
units.english: "They're saints, or relics," they say. "Fragments of unliving minds, free of pain and death, surviving in parts. Each one was once a mind of renown, one worth preserving even as a memory. They're intrigued by thee. Only one of them ever saw something of your kind, and it did not expect to ever see one of you again - not even in eternity."
units.italian: "Sono santi, o reliquie," dicono. "Frammenti di menti non viventi, libere dal dolore e dalla morte, che sopravvivono in parti. Ognuna era un tempo una mente di grande fama, degna di essere conservata anche solo come ricordo. Sono incuriositi da te. Solo uno di loro ha mai visto qualcosa della tua specie, e non si aspettava di rivederne uno, nemmeno nell'eternità."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"And who are you?" you ask.|54|0
units.english: "And who are you?" you ask.
units.italian: "E tu chi sei?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	They splay their arms, a little more subtly than most of the Successors you've seen. "Aqrabe I- Sola. And you are Captain <first> <last>. How queer an introduction is to thee, for thou art the only one here for whom 'twould be needed." They make a noise you're sure is chuckling. "A scion of Aqrabe's House - by marriage, not by blood. But only just. But now, tell me, how is it that our wormhole grants thee passage without a well-equipped ship of ours?"|56|0
units.english: They splay their arms, a little more subtly than most of the Successors you've seen. "Aqrabe I- Sola. And you are Captain <first> <last>. How queer an introduction is to thee, for thou art the only one here for whom 'twould be needed." They make a noise you're sure is chuckling. "A scion of Aqrabe's House - by marriage, not by blood. But only just. But now, tell me, how is it that our wormhole grants thee passage without a well-equipped ship of ours?"
units.italian: Aprono le braccia, con un gesto un po' più discreto di quello della maggior parte dei Successori che hai visto. "Aqrabe I- Sola. E tu sei il capitano <first> <last>. Che strana presentazione è per te, visto che sei l'unico qui per cui sarebbe necessaria." Fanno un rumore che sei certo sia un ridacchiare. "Un erede della Casa di Aqrabe, per matrimonio, non per sangue. Ma per poco. Ma ora dimmi: come mai il nostro wormhole ti concede il passaggio senza una nostra nave ben attrezzata?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"I carry a quantum keystone on my ship that lets me pass through all sorts of unstable wormholes."|58|0
units.english: "I carry a quantum keystone on my ship that lets me pass through all sorts of unstable wormholes."
units.italian: "Porto sulla nave una pietra chiave quantistica che mi permette di attraversare ogni sorta di wormhole instabile."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"That's not something I'm comfortable sharing."|60|0
units.english: "That's not something I'm comfortable sharing."
units.italian: "Non è una cosa che mi sento di condividere."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"Oh, don't think we haven't scanned thy craft, Captain! Amateur secrecy shall get thee nowhere." A slow ripple of pale blue cascades over their face.|63|0
units.english: "Oh, don't think we haven't scanned thy craft, Captain! Amateur secrecy shall get thee nowhere." A slow ripple of pale blue cascades over their face.
units.italian: "Oh, non pensare che non abbiamo scansionato la tua nave, capitano! La segretezza da dilettanti non ti porterà da nessuna parte." Una lenta increspatura di azzurro pallido scende sul loro volto.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	Sola nods. "In short, we wish to better know these stones of thine. Their structure, their function, their nature. And by this understanding of one more great mystery, to one day produce our own, less intensive and demanding than the forming of our armors. Aqrabe is willing to pay thee to deliver fifty of these to us, more than enough to offset whatever it costs thee for their acquisition."|65|0
units.english: Sola nods. "In short, we wish to better know these stones of thine. Their structure, their function, their nature. And by this understanding of one more great mystery, to one day produce our own, less intensive and demanding than the forming of our armors. Aqrabe is willing to pay thee to deliver fifty of these to us, more than enough to offset whatever it costs thee for their acquisition."
units.italian: Sola annuisce. "In breve, vogliamo conoscere meglio queste tue pietre. La loro struttura, la loro funzione, la loro natura. E grazie a questa comprensione di un altro grande mistero, un giorno produrre le nostre, meno intensive e meno esigenti della formatura delle nostre corazze. Aqrabe è disposta a pagarti perché gliene consegni cinquanta, più che sufficienti a compensare qualunque costo tu debba sostenere per procurartele."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"Very well, I accept."|67|0
units.english: "Very well, I accept."
units.italian: "Molto bene, accetto."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	"I'd rather not work with Aqrabe."|68|0
units.english: "I'd rather not work with Aqrabe."
units.italian: "Preferirei non lavorare con Aqrabe."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	The scion shimmers with pleasure, and bow to you slightly. "What joy 'tis to hear that, Captain. Return when thou canst, then. We shall see thee rewarded."|70|0
units.english: The scion shimmers with pleasure, and bow to you slightly. "What joy 'tis to hear that, Captain. Return when thou canst, then. We shall see thee rewarded."
units.italian: L'erede scintilla di piacere e ti fa un lieve inchino. "Che gioia sentirlo, capitano. Torna quando puoi, allora. Ti vedremo ricompensato."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|log|77|0
units.english: Delivered a shipment of quantum keystones to House Aqrabe for study and installation on their ships.
units.italian: Hai consegnato a Casa Aqrabe una partita di pietre chiave quantistiche perché le studino e le installino sulle loro navi.

units.id: conversation:successor keystone delivery|	As soon as you inform traffic control that you are returning with the fifty keystones that House Aqrabe requested, your ship is directed to a side hangar surrounded by multiple small outfitting bays. Most are shuttered, but one is brightly lit and full of activity. It seems to be the domain of some of House Aqrabe's more unorthodox research efforts - the walls are draped with strange-looking fabrics, and a couple of unusual, abstract statues dot its interior. In the center, a ship-mounted scanner is in the midst of being deconstructed; as you walk in, a Successor pops their head around from behind it.|80|0
units.english: As soon as you inform traffic control that you are returning with the fifty keystones that House Aqrabe requested, your ship is directed to a side hangar surrounded by multiple small outfitting bays. Most are shuttered, but one is brightly lit and full of activity. It seems to be the domain of some of House Aqrabe's more unorthodox research efforts - the walls are draped with strange-looking fabrics, and a couple of unusual, abstract statues dot its interior. In the center, a ship-mounted scanner is in the midst of being deconstructed; as you walk in, a Successor pops their head around from behind it.
units.italian: Appena comunichi al controllo del traffico che stai tornando con le cinquanta pietre chiave richieste da Casa Aqrabe, la tua nave viene indirizzata a un hangar laterale circondato da diversi piccoli vani di allestimento. La maggior parte è chiusa, ma uno è ben illuminato e pieno di attività. Sembra il dominio di alcune delle ricerche più eterodosse di Casa Aqrabe: le pareti sono drappeggiate di tessuti dall'aspetto strano, e un paio di statue inusuali e astratte punteggiano l'interno. Al centro, uno scanner montato su nave è in fase di smontaggio; mentre entri, un Successore sporge la testa da dietro.

units.id: conversation:successor keystone delivery|	"Captain <last>?" they ask.|81|0
units.english: "Captain <last>?" they ask.
units.italian: "Capitano <last>?" chiedono.

units.id: conversation:successor keystone delivery|	"Yes?"|82|0
units.english: "Yes?"
units.italian: "Sì?"

units.id: conversation:successor keystone delivery|	They slither forward towards you and splay their arms in the traditional gesture. "Tiliia," they offer as an introduction. "I was told to expect thine arrival. Thou hast brought," and they pause to pronounce the word, "keystones, yes?"|83|0
units.english: They slither forward towards you and splay their arms in the traditional gesture. "Tiliia," they offer as an introduction. "I was told to expect thine arrival. Thou hast brought," and they pause to pronounce the word, "keystones, yes?"
units.italian: Scivolano verso di te e aprono le braccia nel gesto tradizionale. "Tiliia," si presentano. "Mi avevano detto di aspettare il tuo arrivo. Hai portato," e si fermano per pronunciare bene la parola, "pietre chiave, giusto?"

units.id: conversation:successor keystone delivery|	"I have," you say. "Fifty keystones, as was requested." Tiliia joins you in walking back to the <ship> to examine the cargo; when they're sufficiently satisfied that you've brought the proper amount, they pull out a data-pad and enter a couple of values. Though their eyes widen when you provide them with your receipts, they nonetheless confirm a few moments later that House Aqrabe has credited you to offset the purchase price of the keystones, plus a three hundred thousand-credit bonus.|84|0
units.english: "I have," you say. "Fifty keystones, as was requested." Tiliia joins you in walking back to the <ship> to examine the cargo; when they're sufficiently satisfied that you've brought the proper amount, they pull out a data-pad and enter a couple of values. Though their eyes widen when you provide them with your receipts, they nonetheless confirm a few moments later that House Aqrabe has credited you to offset the purchase price of the keystones, plus a three hundred thousand-credit bonus.
units.italian: "Sì," dici. "Cinquanta pietre chiave, come richiesto." Tiliia ti accompagna alla <ship> per esaminare il carico; quando è sufficientemente soddisfatta che tu abbia portato la quantità giusta, tira fuori un datapad e inserisce un paio di valori. Sebbene gli occhi si allarghino quando gli porgi le ricevute, confermano comunque pochi istanti dopo che Casa Aqrabe ti ha accreditato il prezzo d'acquisto delle pietre chiave, più un bonus di trecentomila crediti.

units.id: conversation:successor keystone delivery|	As they begin directing ground crews to offload the keystones, Tiliia turns to you for a moment and requests that you meet them back at the spaceport by the end of the day: "thine assistance might be a boon to us in the next part of this journey," they say.|85|0
units.english: As they begin directing ground crews to offload the keystones, Tiliia turns to you for a moment and requests that you meet them back at the spaceport by the end of the day: "thine assistance might be a boon to us in the next part of this journey," they say.
units.italian: Mentre cominciano a dirigere le squadre di terra per lo scarico delle pietre chiave, Tiliia si volta un momento verso di te e ti chiede di incontrarli allo spazioporto entro la fine della giornata: "il tuo aiuto potrebbe essere un vantaggio per noi nella prossima parte di questo viaggio," dicono.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe Remnant|name|89|0
units.english: Source keystones from the Remnant
units.italian: Procurati le pietre chiave dai Remnant

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe Remnant|description|90|0
units.english: House Aqrabe wants a total of 50 Quantum Key Stones at <destination>, which can be obtained in bulk from the Remnant.
units.italian: Casa Aqrabe vuole un totale di 50 Pietre Chiave Quantistiche su <destination>, che si possono ottenere in grandi quantità dai Remnant.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe Hai|name|107|0
units.english: Source keystones from the Hai
units.italian: Procurati le pietre chiave dagli Hai

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe Hai|description|108|0
units.english: House Aqrabe wants a total of 50 Quantum Keystones at <destination>, which can be obtained in bulk from the Hai.
units.italian: Casa Aqrabe vuole un totale di 50 Pietre Chiave Quantistiche su <destination>, che si possono ottenere in grandi quantità dagli Hai.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|name|125|0
units.english: Keystone testing
units.italian: Prova delle pietre chiave

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|description|126|0
units.english: Escort two of House Aqrabe's ships through the wormhole and convene with them at <stopovers> before returning to <planet>.
units.italian: Scorta due navi di Casa Aqrabe attraverso il wormhole e radunati con loro a <stopovers> prima di tornare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|log|136|0
units.english: People
units.italian: People

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|Tiliia meets you in another tucked-away part of the spaceport that's filled with strange statuary, where they stand in conversation with a small group of Successors. They brighten as they see you approach and offer a perfunctory splay of the arms. "Captain, captain," they say. "Thou returnest with no time to squander. We mean to ply a journey of understanding cross the wormhole; one fellow captain here means to use one of thy keystones, the other, our weft-weaving armor. Thy own craft would be valuable as a place to gather data from the other two, to see how they perform across the rift."|138|0
units.english: Tiliia meets you in another tucked-away part of the spaceport that's filled with strange statuary, where they stand in conversation with a small group of Successors. They brighten as they see you approach and offer a perfunctory splay of the arms. "Captain, captain," they say. "Thou returnest with no time to squander. We mean to ply a journey of understanding cross the wormhole; one fellow captain here means to use one of thy keystones, the other, our weft-weaving armor. Thy own craft would be valuable as a place to gather data from the other two, to see how they perform across the rift."
units.italian: Tiliia ti incontra in un'altra parte nascosta dello spazioporto, piena di statue strane, dove sono in conversazione con un piccolo gruppo di Successori. Si illuminano quando ti vedono avvicinare e offrono un rapido gesto delle braccia. "Capitano, capitano," dicono. "Torni senza tempo da perdere. Vogliamo intraprendere un viaggio di comprensione attraverso il wormhole; un capitano qui vuole usare una delle tue pietre chiave, l'altro la nostra corazza tessuta. La tua nave sarebbe preziosa come punto di raccolta dati sulle altre due, per vedere come si comportano attraverso la frattura."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|	"Couldn't you do that without me?"|140|0
units.english: "Couldn't you do that without me?"
units.italian: "Non potreste farlo senza di me?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|	"Where exactly are we going?"|141|0
units.english: "Where exactly are we going?"
units.italian: "Dove andiamo esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|	Tiliia shimmers with mirth. "Of course," they say. "But were we to find ourselves with questions, needing knowledge that though might'st provide, 'twould be val'ble to have thee at our sides then. We plan to convene upon the dusty world just the other side of the gate; I shall hope to see thee there."|143|0
units.english: Tiliia shimmers with mirth. "Of course," they say. "But were we to find ourselves with questions, needing knowledge that though might'st provide, 'twould be val'ble to have thee at our sides then. We plan to convene upon the dusty world just the other side of the gate; I shall hope to see thee there."
units.italian: Tiliia scintilla di ilarità. "Certo," dicono. "Ma se ci trovassimo con delle domande, bisognosi di conoscenze che tu potresti fornire, sarebbe prezioso averti al nostro fianco in quel momento. Contiamo di radunarci sul mondo polveroso appena oltre la porta; spero di vederti lì."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|	Ripples of blue envelop Tiliia's body. "As short a distance as we might. We may convene upon the burned world the other side of the wormhole."|146|0
units.english: Ripples of blue envelop Tiliia's body. "As short a distance as we might. We may convene upon the burned world the other side of the wormhole."
units.italian: Increspature blu avvolgono il corpo di Tiliia. "Il più breve tratto possibile. Possiamo radunarci sul mondo bruciato oltre il wormhole."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|The two Seiitejen set down along with the <ship> along the edge of a dried lake, and Tiliia immediately goes to communicate with their captains over comms. After a couple of minutes, they join you on your bridge, noting down some data on a metallic pad. "The other craft report little issue with their journeys," they say. "And a minor quiver'f differences 'tween thy stones and our armor. But 'twill require us t'return t'make sense of them - I dare not do so here."|155|0
units.english: The two Seiitejen set down along with the <ship> along the edge of a dried lake, and Tiliia immediately goes to communicate with their captains over comms. After a couple of minutes, they join you on your bridge, noting down some data on a metallic pad. "The other craft report little issue with their journeys," they say. "And a minor quiver'f differences 'tween thy stones and our armor. But 'twill require us t'return t'make sense of them - I dare not do so here."
units.italian: I due Seiitejen si posano insieme alla <ship> sul bordo di un lago prosciugato, e Tiliia va subito a comunicare con i loro capitani via radio. Dopo un paio di minuti si uniscono a te sulla plancia, annotando dati su una tavoletta metallica. "Le altre navi riferiscono pochi problemi nel viaggio," dicono. "E una lieve differenza fra le tue pietre e la nostra corazza. Ma servirà tornare per capirci qualcosa: non oso farlo qui."

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|dialog|157|0
units.english: Tiliia offers a quick goodbye and asks you to meet them back in the spaceport later, once they've had time to process their data.
units.italian: Tiliia si congeda in fretta e ti chiede di incontrarli più tardi allo spazioporto, quando avranno avuto il tempo di elaborare i loro dati.
